g.text: $ python -m heat3d_cs2 demos --help
usage: heat3d_cs2 demos [-h] -o OUT [--every EVERY] [--jobs JOBS] [--map MAP]
[--force] [--no-bulk] [--container] [--loose]
paths [paths ...]
positional arguments:
paths demo files or folders
options:
-h, --help show this help message and exit
-o, --out OUT folder to write into
--every EVERY sample players every N ticks (64 a second; default 8: 8 a
second)
--jobs JOBS matches converted at once (default: half the cores)
--map MAP only matches whose name contains this, e.g. mirage
--force rewrite matches already written
--no-bulk leave the entity stream, the players' commands and the
animation (over half a demo's size) out of the packets
sidecar; the self-check counts them lost
--container pack each match into one .3dheat file (the default)
--loose keep each match as separate files (table, match.json,
sidecars), not one .3dheat container
